messages:
alicia: Heads-up — since we flipped centralized VPC flow-logs -> s3 via vpc-log-proxy yesterday, we're seeing GPU node provisioning failures in eu-west-1 and a 3x NAT gateway cost spike. Anyone else seeing this?

mohit: Yep. Node bootstrap logs show KMS_ACCESS_DENIED when trying to decrypt /keystore/node-secrets. Also lots of 403s on s3 PutObject from the shipper.

jordan: We only changed route tables to force logs through the proxy subnets. Could be the proxy buffering uploads via NAT. NAT metrics show sustained 30-60 MB/s egress from the proxy subnets during peaks. :eyes:

ops-bot: deploy-bot: flowlogs-shipper-v2 was rolled to vpc-log-proxy cluster at 22:04 UTC (sha: a1b2c3).

security: We rotated the central KMS policy last week and removed cross-account decrypt for the vpc-log-proxy role as part of tightening. That would explain the KMS errors for any component still relying on old access.

mina: Quick mitigation: re-grant kms:Decrypt and s3:GetObject to role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/vpc-log-proxy-shipper on the log-bucket and /keystore prefix. That should let bootstrap complete while we plan a safer fix.

mohit: Agreed, but we need to stop the NAT burn. Longer-term fix is to attach an S3 VPC endpoint to the log-proxy subnets so uploads don't go out via NAT.

jordan: Also noticed the shipper now parallelizes uploads 8x for speed. With large log bursts that multiplies concurrent outbound connections and NAT usage. We should throttle to 1-2 concurrent uploads per pod.

sre-oncall: I'm opening a billing alert and a rollback ticket for the KMS tweak. Will also create a task to provision an S3 endpoint in eu-west-1 for the proxy route tables.

security: Recommended action list: 
1) Temporarily restore minimal kms:Decrypt for vpc-log-proxy role (scoped to keystore objects only).
2) Add s3:GetObject/PutObject for the log bucket (shipper prefix) to that role.
3) Provision VPC S3 endpoint for proxy subnets and add route table entries.
4) Reduce shipper parallelism to 1 and increase buffer flush interval to avoid NAT spikes.
5) Add temporary billing alert (NAT egress > $200/hr) and tag costs to INFRA-LOGS for chargeback.

alicia: Assigning: @mohit to KMS & bucket ACL fix, @jordan to shipper config and helm chart, @sre-oncall to VPC endpoint + billing alert. I'll ping product for postmortem notes. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: jira: INFRA-4021 created — "Restore log role KMS access & add S3 VPC endpoint for vpc-log-proxy" (priority: P1).

mohit: I'll push the policy hotfix now, will comment the PR with the minimal policy lines.

jordan: I'll cut a shipper patch to clamp concurrency and prepare a Helm roll for the proxy namespace. Will test in staging first.

sre-oncall: Endpoint request queued with network-ops, ETA ~2 hours. Billing alert set.

alicia: Good. Keep updates here. If bootstrap failures continue after the policy rollback, we'll revert the route flip and fall back to old flowlog path.

security: Follow-up note — after we finish, we'll create a hardened runbook so future log routing changes include a KMS/access checklist and cost-impact review.

mohit: Patch PR: https://github.com/redwood-infra/iam/pull/182 (policy delta included).

jordan: Ship patch link: https://github.com/redwood-infra/flowlogs-shipper/pull/57 — throttling default -> 1.

sre-oncall: NAT egress trending down after throttling test in staging. Monitoring for 30 min. :chart_with_downwards_trend:
